attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30,2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of IPO proceeds. Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited issued the report. The net proceeds available for utilization were Rs. 168.06 crore. The company utilized Rs. 129.46 crore as of the quarter end. Unutilized proceeds stood at Rs. 38.60 crore, excluding interest. The remaining funds were invested in fixed deposits with ICICI Bank. The total amount invested in these instruments was Rs. 43.79 crore. The report confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. The company is a manufacturer of tractors and pick and carry cranes. The IPO was conducted between December 31, 2024, and January 02, 2025.

attchmntText: Indo Farm Equipment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone profit after tax was 462.12 lakhs for the quarter and 967.87 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit after tax was 539.99 lakhs for the quarter and 1,105.73 lakhs for the half year. Standalone revenue from operations was 10,896.10 lakhs for the quarter and 21,389.31 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations was 11,459.46 lakhs for the quarter and 22,483.76 lakhs for the half year. Standalone basic earnings per share was 0.96 for the quarter and 2.01 for the half year. Consolidated basic earnings per share was 1.12 for the quarter and 2.30 for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the limited review of these results.
